A nemesis shawl is a white cotton capelet until its wearer dies, at which point a detailed tapestry bleeds into the fabric of the shawl and leaves a permanent depiction of their death. When you die wearing a nemesis shawl, the shroud wraps itself tightly around a portion of your remains. The shawl can then be used instead of your remains for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Resurrect] ritual, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Raise Dead] spell, and similar effects even if your body has exploded, withered to dust, or is otherwise not intact.

Activate—Final Curse f

Frequency once per day

Trigger You're about to gain the dying condition from damage dealt by a creature within 20 feet

Effect You use your final breath to curse your killer, causing it to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 1}; this is an emotion, fear, and mental effect. Your body then explodes, dealing @Damage[15d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] with a @Check[reflex|dc:38|basic|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save. You immediately die.
